notes: Confirmed against two authoritative Crown/HARMAN sources: the CDi 1000 Architectural & Engineering Specifications sheet (Crown International, 2007, doc 139681-1D) and the CDi Series Operation Manual (Harman International, 2012, doc 5021543, covering CDi1000/2000/4000/6000). Input Connector: two 3-pin removable Phoenix-type (euroblock) connectors, one per channel (CH1, CH2), each taking a balanced line-level signal (mapped here as two ports "Input 1" and "Input 2" since each terminal block is a separate physical connector). Output Connectors: a single 4-position barrier strip (mapped as one bidirectional-use pair covering both dual-channel and bridge-mono wiring; modeled here as two output positions CH1/CH2 per the barrier strip layout, consistent with barrier-strip/euroblock representation used elsewhere in this catalog for Crown amps) usable as 2 discrete 2-8ohm/70V loudspeaker outputs or bridged to one 4-8ohm/140V mono output — connector is a fixed screw/barrier terminal strip, closest listed id is "euroblock" (not a true pluggable Euroblock; it's a fixed barrier strip, same convention used for other Crown amps in this catalog). AC Line Connector is NEMA 5-15P (15A) — note some third-party marketing copy for this exact SKU aggregates the CDi series and can misstate this as IEC; the primary A&E spec sheet and Operation Manual both explicitly specify NEMA 5-15P for the CDi 1000/2000/4000 chassis (the larger CDi 6000 uses NEMA 6-20P instead). HiQnet USB port (Type B) is a PC configuration/control link, not general USB host storage — mapped as usb-b bidirectional; no bandwidth grade stated in spec (USB revision unspecified), so grade omitted. No Ethernet/network port exists on this model (HiQnet control here is USB-only, unlike the newer DCi series which adds BLU Link/Ethernet). Rack height 3.5 in = 2 rack units.

ports.name: Input 1
ports.note: 3-pin removable Phoenix-type (euroblock) connector, balanced line-level input, Channel 1.

ports.name: Input 2
ports.note: 3-pin removable Phoenix-type (euroblock) connector, balanced line-level input, Channel 2.

ports.name: Output
ports.note: 4-position fixed barrier strip (CH1+/CH1-/CH2+/CH2-). Dual mode: two independent loudspeaker outputs, 2-8 ohm or 70V/140V constant-voltage. Bridge-mono mode: bridged across the two channel-1 positions for a single 4-8 ohm or 140V output. Not a pluggable Euroblock — fixed barrier terminal strip; euroblock is the closest listed connector id.

ports.name: USB (HiQnet)
ports.note: Type B USB port for HiQnet PC control/configuration software (System Architect). USB revision not stated in spec; no bandwidth grade given.

ports.name: AC Line
ports.note: NEMA 5-15P (15A) captive/detachable AC line cordset inlet. Universal switch-mode supply accepts 100V/120V/220-240V, 50/60Hz.
